# tool-permission-policy

> Declarative allow, ask and deny policies for agent tool calls: tool name globs, argument constraints on paths, hosts, values and numbers, context conditions and fail-closed deny Python package `trysac-tool-permission-policy`, import name `tool_permission_policy`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
